question: For ports on host "drive-59" that are administratively up and have at least one IP allocation, show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, the number of IP allocations on the port, the total number of subnet-id rows among those allocations, and the running sum of port standard attribute IDs within each VIF type group ordered by standard attribute ID. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH port_ip_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.mac_address,
    p.standard_attr_id,
    b.vif_type,
    COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows
  FROM ports p
  INNER JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  INNER JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND b.host = 'drive-59'
  GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.standard_attr_id, b.vif_type
)
SELECT 
  port_id,
  tenant_id,
  mac_address,
  ip_allocation_count,
  subnet_id_rows,
  SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY vif_type ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_standard_attr_id
FROM port_ip_summary

Window: running_sum_standard_attr_id is a cumulative sum of ports.standard_attr_id within each vif_type group, ordered by standard_attr_id. This matches the question's request for a running sum within VIF type groups.

Grain: The query groups by port attributes and vif_type, ensuring one row per port-vif_type combination. The window function operates on this aggregated result, which is correct for a running sum over distinct ports.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  p.id AS port_id,
  p.tenant_id,
  p.mac_address,
  COUNT(i.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count,
  COUNT(i.subnet_id) AS subnet_id_row_count,
  SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr
FROM ports p
JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
JOIN ipallocations i ON i.port_id = p.id
WHERE b.host = 'drive-59'
  AND p.admin_state_up = 1
GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.standard_attr_id, b.vif_type
ORDER BY b.vif_type, p.standard_attr_id;

  SELECT 
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.mac_address,
    p.standard_attr_id,
    b.vif_type,
    COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ia.subnet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows
  FROM ports p
  INNER JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  INNER JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND b.host = 'drive-59'
  GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.standard_attr_id, b.vif_type
)
SELECT 
  port_id,
  tenant_id,
  mac_address,
  ip_allocation_count,
  subnet_id_rows,
  SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY vif_type ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_standard_attr_id
FROM port_ip_summary
